The yee saltwater fish tank is a fish tank that combines the versatility of freshwater and saltwater. It is cleverly designed to seamlessly adapt to a variety of aquatic environments. The frameless glass design brings players the ultimate visual experience.View more rimless fish tank.

 

Saltwater fish tank with advanced filtration system

This fish tank cleverly integrates an extra-large filter chamber with a capacity of up to 7200 cubic centimeters. For saltwater aquariums, you can easily add advanced protein skimmers and biofilter bags to the filter chamber to meet stringent filtration requirements. For freshwater environments, you can simply replace it with a traditional filter sponge. In addition, the porous water-blocking plate technology ensures that the water flow is evenly distributed, improving filtration efficiency and water purification capabilities.

Thoughtful design details

The yee saltwater fish tank has an oil film removal port cleverly designed on the top. It can easily remove oil and floating impurities on the surface. In this way, the water quality can always remain clear. Not only that, the yee saltwater fish tank also has a drain port designed at the bottom. The design of this drain port is very clever.
It can completely remove waste and uneaten food. Therefore, the aquarium can remain clean and beautiful.

 

Innovative water outlet

The innovative 360° rotating duckbill outlet not only enhances dissolved oxygen and creates natural waves, but also further removes oil and sediment to improve water quality. This design revitalizes the water quality and provides a healthier living environment for fish.

 

Adjustable sand baffle

Yee saltwater fish tanks solve a common problem with traditional filtered water inlets. That is, the water inlet will limit the thickness of the sand bed. For this reason, Yee has specially designed an adjustable sand baffle. This sand baffle is cleverly located at the water inlet at the bottom of the fish tank. With it, you are no longer restricted by the water inlet. Now you can freely create your ideal sandscape. Enjoy the fun of landscaping!

 

Water level monitoring design

The yee saltwater fish tank is not only versatile, but also has a water level monitoring design. This design is cleverly located on both sides of the aquarium. Through it, you can always know the water level in the filter. In this way, you can more easily monitor the operating status of the aquarium.  This function ensures a stable and harmonious aquarium environment, allowing your fish to grow healthily.

excerpt.rendered:
• Advanced filtration system.
  • Innovative water outlet.
  • Adjustable sand baffle.
  • Thoughtful design details.
  • Water level monitoring design.
